reviews.comment:
Todo muy lindo si, baños limpios, buena atencion, agua caliente, rica hamburguesa con porcíon de papa bien generosa y hasta que llegamos para mi, al detaĺle importante, la discriminacion.!?? O eso vivi cuando estuve... Sos socio de ACA.? Fantastico sino solo ves cartelitos por todos lados, "Reservado para Socios ACA" crei deberia ir a comer afuera, esto arruino para mi todo lo anterior. Faltaba personal, perdida de tiempo y no sigo porque ya escribiria demasiado...

(Translated by Google)
Everything was great, yes: clean bathrooms, good service, hot water, delicious burger with a generous portion of fries, and then we get to the most important detail for me: discrimination! Or at least that's what I experienced when I was there... Are you an ACA member? Fantastic, otherwise you just see signs everywhere saying "Reserved for ACA Members." I thought I'd have to eat elsewhere, but this ruined everything else for me. There was a staff shortage, it was a waste of time, and I won't go on because I'd already be writing too much...
